_comment: Hand-edited INPUT: the six characters (docs/show-night.md), one per sequence slot, and their voices. engine picks what tools/skit.py uses (--engine overrides). elevenlabs: a voice id from the account (premade; name for reference), model eleven_v3 unless set, key in ELEVENLABS_API_KEY. piper (fallback, local and free): models live in the show folder's Voices/ (python -m piper.download_voices --data-dir <show>/Voices <model>); pitch is in semitones; length > 1 speaks slower.
